{{Current events|year=2022|month=11|day=11|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Ukrainian Ground Forces|Ukrainian troops]] enter the city of [[Kherson]], the only Ukrainian regional capital captured by Russia during the invasion, ending [[Kherson#2022 Russian occupation|the city's eight-month occupation]] by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/11/europe/russian-troops-leave-kherson-region-intl (CNN)]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] destroy the [[Antonivka Road Bridge]] as they [[Withdrawal (military)|retreat]] from the west of the [[Dnieper]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/11/11/world/europe/kherson-bridge-russia-ukraine-war.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[United States and the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****The [[Russian Foreign Ministry]] bans 200 [[Citizenship of the United States|U.S. citizens]] from entering [[Russia]], including [[White House Press Secretary]] [[Karine Jean-Pierre]] and three siblings of [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-bans-entry-200-us-nationals-including-bidens-relatives-press-secretary-2022-11-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 food crises]], [[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[Food and Agriculture Organization]] forecasts that by the year's end, global [[food prices|spending on food]] imports will have increased by 10 percent from the previous year to reach "an all-time high" of [[United States dollar|US$]]1.94 trillion, due to [[Currency appreciation and depreciation|currency depreciations]] and the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|war in Ukraine]]. "The bulk" of this increase in spending will be by [[High-income country|high-income countries]] while food import "volumes are also expected to rise." [https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/global-food-import-bill-to-jump-to-record-1-9-trillion-uns-fao/articleshow/95448743.cms (AFP via ''The Economic Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed when a [[tank truck]] explodes in [[Ofu, Nigeria| Ofu]], [[Kogi State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/africa-business-explosions-nigeria-36d8d49a6ef73fe35616ce67520cd02a (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of East Timor to ASEAN]]
**[[East Timor]] is granted observer member status of the [[ASEAN]] bloc of nations, with a roadmap to membership established. The country welcomes the decision as it currently experiences high levels of [[unemployment]] and [[malnourishment]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2435599/east-timor-gets-the-nod-to-join-asean-grouping (AFP via ''The Bangkok Post'')]
*[[UN motion to seek ICJ opinion on the legal implications of Israel's occupation of Palestinian territory‎]]
**The [[United Nations General Assembly Fourth Committee]] adopts a resolution to request the opinion of the [[International Court of Justice]] (ICJ) on the effects of the [[Israeli-occupied territories|Israeli occupation of the Palestinian territories]]. It will then proceed to the [[United Nations General Assembly]] for final approval. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2022-11-11/ty-article/.premium/un-votes-to-bring-israeli-occupation-of-palestinian-territories-before-intl-court/00000184-6791-d779-a5bc-fff7c9420000 (''Haaretz'')]
